label: See Father Godscalc out properly
description: What he brought back out of Africa has been killing him for four years. Nothing in the house's power alters that; only how it is met.

label: Bring the northern venture home
description: Form the three hulls into one convoy, carry salt north to the Iceland stations, and land at least 40 barrels of stockfish at Bruges between them — the combined hold is the point, no single ship can do it. An escort is expensive and halves what the crossing costs in losses. The season shuts in 40 weeks.

label: Stage the Nativity at the Scottish court
description: A nominal fee and an audience that decides who holds the burgh's customs next year.

label: Survive what Burgundy asks for
description: The duke wants money against revenues already pledged three times over. Refusing costs something in Flanders immediately; lending costs something later, at Trier.

label: Settle the house's position in the Volterra alum
description: Alum on a subject town's own hillside, in a state whose leading family has never let a profitable thing belong to somebody else. How deep the house stands in it is the whole question.

label: The families under the ash
description: A week's delay and a hold given over to people instead of fish. Doesn't gate the chapter — just marks the choice.
